description: How many members of the House of Lords each party or group has on a given date, including Crossbench peers, Bishops and non-affiliated members, from the UK Parliament Members API state of the parties. Useful for "how big is the Lords?" and Lords reform questions. Totals may differ slightly from Parliament's published figures depending on how members on leave are counted. (cost: 1 credit)

date.description: string, optional, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future; default today (UTC)

name: lords_party_composition
